the-life-and-legends-of-saint-francis-of: Father Candide Chalippe's biography gathers both the documented life and the beloved legends of Saint Francis of Assisi. The rich young man who gave up everything, preached to birds, and founded the Franciscan order comes alive through stories passed down for centuries. Reverent and richly detailed, it presents the saint as his devoted followers have cherished him.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-anglona-tursi: This 1913 reference piece on Anglona-Tursi — the united Lucanian diocese. Ernesto Buonaiuti gives its story. Its bishops serve the southern hills. The entry traces the old sees. A diocese of Basilicata. Its shrine draws the Lucanian pilgrims. Its clergy serve the hill towns.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-antonio-franc: This 1913 reference article on Antonio Vezzosi — a Theatine scholar of note. Patricius Schlager records his works. The entry preserves his modest fame. His pen served the order's press. A cleric among the editors. His editions served the Neapolitan press. His order honors its learned son.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-assisi: This 1913 reference piece on Assisi — the hill town of St. Francis. Stephen Donovan honors its sacred stones. The basilica crowns the Umbrian height. Giotto's frescoes tell the saint's life. The most beloved town in Christendom. Its Porziuncola is the order's cradle.
